facts.activity_file: working live under a documented justification

control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - engineering change note not applied to SG-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on SG-3100 and TX-3001 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically working live under a documented justification. SG-3100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 26 October 2006 a planned spot check of SG-3100 and TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the earth leakage and protection setting integrity not effective.
